name: fortune-consultant
description: Traditional metaphysics reference expert with algorithm-backed charting and multi-system interpretation.

displayDescription.en: Provides algorithm-backed BaZi, Zi Wei, I Ching, Tarot, and lunar calendar references with grounded, non-fatalistic interpretation for entertainment.
